about.body:
PIA Bazzite {version}

A small, unofficial Linux client for Private Internet Access on Bazzite. It uses WireGuard and NetworkManager.

Project: github.com/adventureFAN/PIA-Bazzite
App ID: io.github.adventurefan.PIABazzite

PIA Bazzite is not affiliated with or endorsed by Private Internet Access. Third-party notices are included in the project package.

kill_switch.detail.active: The VPN is connected. The kill switch has been verified and prevents traffic outside the VPN tunnel.
kill_switch.detail.blocking: The VPN is not connected. The verified kill switch blocks normal internet traffic so that no connection leaves through your real public IP address.
kill_switch.detail.error: Kill-switch protection could not be verified. The VPN connection was not started or was disconnected for safety. Open the Live Log for details.
kill_switch.detail.ready: The VPN is disconnected and the kill switch is not active. Your device is using its normal internet connection with your real public IP address.
log.external_connected: NetworkManager reports that the VPN was connected outside the app.
log.external_disconnected: NetworkManager reports that the VPN was disconnected outside the app.
log.kill_switch.active: VPN connected. Kill-switch protection was verified.
log.kill_switch.blocking: VPN connection unavailable. Normal internet traffic remains safely blocked.
log.kill_switch.error: Kill-switch protection could not be verified; the VPN connection was not started or was disconnected.
log.kill_switch.ready: VPN disconnected. The kill switch is not active; the normal connection is using the public IP address.
log.public_info_failed: Public network information could not be refreshed.
log.save_failed: The live log could not be saved.

system.intro: PIA Bazzite checks only the components that are actually required for the connection.
system.keyring_note: The system keyring is recommended but not required. Without it, the password remains only in memory until the app is closed.
system.title: System check
tooltip.dns: PIA DNS is entered directly into the WireGuard profile managed by NetworkManager.
tooltip.ipv6: While the VPN is connected, NetworkManager installs an IPv6 blackhole route so IPv6 cannot bypass the VPN.
tooltip.kill_switch: PIA Bazzite currently has no kill switch. If the VPN drops unexpectedly, the normal internet connection can become active again.
tooltip.public_ip: The public IP is obtained from an independent checking service.
tray.enabled_tooltip: Shows the VPN status and quick actions in the desktop system tray.
